en: The postcard shows a black-and-white aerial view of a grand building surrounded by lush trees and water, with a stone bridge leading to the entrance. The text at the bottom of the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont. Schloss mit Karpfenteich', suggesting the location is in Bad Pyrmont and features a castle (Schloss) with a carp pond (Karpfenteich). The reverse side has printed lines for address, museum seal 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', and German language text.
